full_test.command: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=.local/t14-target CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test --quiet --features qa

core_fixes: progress_result_task_count no longer rescans the full run history per row; request ownership uses the held run payload plus the unique legacy input-signature fallback
startup same-workspace retry reuses the owned lock and attached store instead of unlinking/reopening the database
recovery plans preserve accepted generations, intent hashes, filtered unsubmitted tail and an atomic snapshot retirement marker; whole-plan validation precedes mutation
task editor saves apply the validated write set directly to live state before submitting; no whole-store clone on the ordinary editor path
exact dirty-exit token and form identity for task, automation and planning requests
standalone automation Save draft completion runs only after the matching receipt and only for the unchanged form; dirty-exit owns the close when present
lazy body replies hydrate only the exact unchanged unloaded revision; stale replies never overwrite newer streaming/regenerated output
rejected/legacy automation save clears the temporary completion handoff so a later command cannot consume it
remaining_limits: Same-process SQLite teardown concurrency depends on the pinned SQLite upgrade; the QA matrix runs isolated child processes and does not claim to prove the lifecycle defect fixed.
